target_customer: Fitness instructors who want to sell live classes, content and branded partnerships
problem: Independent fitness instructors lacked a simple way to monetize live classes and content directly.
business_model: Creator platform for instructors selling live classes and content (fee structure not found)

founders.name: Sahana Rajasekar
founders.background_notes: YC page: full-stack product engineer, designer and fitness instructor. Only founder named; team size was 2.

technical_complexity.rationale: Live class streaming and payments built on existing video and payment services; standard engineering for a solo technical founder.

defensibility.rationale: No network effect or exclusive content is described, and many class platforms existed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not documented for Blok. 2020 coverage shows several platforms launching live class tools, but I could not date them near the March 2020 batch.

market_need_then: The pandemic shifted instructors to online classes in 2020, but no dated demand figures for Blok were found.

branding.domain_note: Used blok.fit; no purchase details found.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or brand pages for this company were found; search results for the name are taken by BLOK London, an unrelated UK fitness brand.

outcome_analysis: Blok was a two person Winter 2020 company building tools for fitness instructors to sell live classes and content, led by a single named founder. No funding, press, shutdown notice or cause was found; the directory marks it inactive, so the cause is not public and failure factors stay empty.
notes: Company website returned HTTP 503. Searches for funding and branding returned BLOK London (an unrelated studio with a 3.75M pound 2022 round), which is not this company. 2020 live class platforms found (Moxie, Stream Fitness, FitGrid) had undated or post-batch sources so were not listed as competitors. Founder education not found.
